'''House Paendrag''' is the ruling house of [[Seanchan]]. The house has its origins in the kingdom of [[Shandalle]] during the [[Free Years]], where [[Artur Hawkwing]] was able to distinguish himself as High King over all the Westlands. The House survived beyond the [[Aryth Ocean]] after [[Luthair Paendrag Mondwin]] sailed west to conquer the rest of the world; meanwhile, in the Westlands, [[House Paeron]] of [[Mayene]] claims descent from House Paendrag.

==Current members==
* [[Radhanan Paendrag]] - Empress of Seanchan, killed by [[Semirhage]].
** [[Aurana Paendrag]] - Daughter of Empress Radhanan, killed by [[Semirhage]].
** [[Chimal Paendrag]] - Daughter of Empress Radhanan, killed by [[Semirhage]].
** [[Ravashi Paendrag]] - Daughter of Empress Radhanan, killed by [[Semirhage]].
** [[Halvate Paendrag]] - Son of Empress Radhanan, assassinated in his youth.
* [[Fortuona Athaem Devi Paendrag]] - Former [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]], now recognized as Empress of Seanchan in their territories in the Westlands
** [[Matrim Cauthon]] - Husband of Empress Fortuona and Prince of the Ravens
*** Unborn child of Empress Fortuona and Matrim Cauthon.
==Historical members==
* Myrdin Paendrag Maregore - King of [[Shandalle]]; died of the [[Black Fever]] in {{fy|939}}
* Mailinde Paendrag Lyndhal - Queen of Shandalle, wife of King Myrdin; died of the Black Fever in {{fy|939}}
* [[Artur Hawkwing|Artur Paendrag Tanreall]] - King of Shandalle; rose to become High King of the Westlands, ruling a single [[Artur Hawkwing's Empire|Empire]]
* [[Amaline Paendrag Tagora]] - First wife of Artur Hawkwing; poisoned in {{fy|961}}
* [[Tamika]] - Second wife of Artur Hawkwing
* [[Amira Paendrag]] - Daughter of Artur Hawkwing; poisoned in {{fy|961}}
* [[Modair Paendrag]] - Son of Artur Hawkwing; died in battle during the [[Consolidation]] in {{fy|959}}
* [[Luthair Paendrag Mondwin]] - Son of Artur Hawkwing; sailed across the Aryth Ocean to conquer Seanchan.
* [[Laiwynde Paendrag]] - Hawkwing's last child to die; died under suspicious circumstances in {{fy|994}} shortly before her father's death.
* Daughter of Artur Hawkwing - Unsuccessfully tried to conquer [[Shara]].
* [[Tyrn sur Paendrag Mashera]] - Son of Laiwynde, supposedly killed with his mother, but later emerged in Mayene and was recognized as First Lord.
* [[Algwyn Paendrag]] - Historical Emperor of Seanchan; distant ancestor of Radhanan.
* [[Varuota Paendrag]] - Historical Empress of Seanchan; great-great grandmother of Radhanan.
